def solve(commands):
    t = commands.split()
    queue, out, i = [], [], 0
    while i < len(t):
        if t[i] == 'E':
            i += 1
            queue.append(int(t[i]))
        elif t[i] == 'D' and queue:
            out.append(queue.pop(0))
        i += 1
    return out
